Name: Cute Cottagecore Furniture Catalog
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[size=4][b]Makes Furnitures[/b] from "[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24999]Cute Cottagecore Furniture for Alternative Textures[/url][/b]" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55973382]Luny [/url]as [color=#ffff00]new object[/color] in [color=#ffff00]new catalog [/color]insted of Alternative Textures!

[/size][size=6]Big thanks to[color=#ff00ff] [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/about-me?gameId=1303][color=#ff00ff]Luny[/color] [/url][/b][/color]for her amazing furniture designs! As she is original creator of the [color=#ff00ff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24999][color=#ff00ff]mod[/color][/url][/color], I encourage everyone who enjoys it to check out her [color=#ff00ff][b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/about-me?gameId=1303][color=#ff00ff]profile[/color][/url][/b][/color]. This mod recreates her furniture as new in-game items, which can be take from a new catalog available from [color=#e69138][b]Carpenter shop[/b][/color]!
[/size][center]
